landed_against.rule: R-17: this slice declares every diff path here and re-captures the baselines it moved in the same commit.

what_landed: Irelia's Ionian Fervor rides the swing ramp on both streams and arms its max-stack on-hit through the retained threshold Volibear's slice built.
why: Hers is Volibear's shape exactly: one count re-rates the swings and turns a rider on where it fills, so the row declares a swing_ramp and an armed_procs rule together. Her cap and her stack's life move out of a module literal and into the binary (IreliaPassive MaxStacks, BuffDuration).

With Rageblade held, so every reading is walked by the same exact walker, over twenty seconds: 24 swings at no stacks, 35 ramped, 35 at a declared full four, the ramped fight worth 5238 against the declared 5264 because the opening swings carry no max-stack hit.

The auto_attacks leaves move UP for the reason the three ramp slices before this one did, and it is not the ramp: no golden Irelia fight holds an item ramp, so each was priced through the per-phase floor, and a kit ramp puts it on the exact walker that keeps the t=0 swing. on_hit_Kraken Slayer at level 11 rises with the swing count and falls at level 18 where the ramp costs more than the extra swing returns.
Her passive had no test of its own before this slice. It has one now, alongside Volibear's, in tests/test_kit_swing_ramp.py.
All 22 pair leaves are hers. No coupled leaf moves: no coupled roster holds Irelia.
